title: The Magnolia - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... "The Magnolia", a laid-back, family-friendly condo in the heart of Seacrest Beach’s Villages of South Walton. “The Magnolia” is your ideal home base for beach days, boutique shopping and poolside fun. This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat comfortably sleeps 7 and offers a charming blend of comfort, convenience and coastal style. With 4 included bikes, updated interiors and access to multiple resort-style pools, you're perfectly positioned between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, making it easy to explore the very best of 30A. Ready to relax? Let’s dive in...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***3 Bedrooms + 2 Bathrooms - Sleeps 7 comfortably across spacious, well-appointed roomsCentral Seacrest Location - Walk to the beach, dining, shops and both Rosemary & Alys BeachAccess to Resort-Style Amenities - Splash pad, zero-entry pool, hot tub and grilling stationsPrivate Balcony - Relax with seating for 4 and coastal breezes4 Bikes Included - Cruise scenic 30A at your own paceWasher & Dryer -Easy clean-up after beach daysIdeal for Families or Groups - Bunk room for the kids, king and queen suites for the adults*** LIVING AREAS ***Open, bright and welcoming, the main living space offers plenty of room for your group to gather after a fun-filled day.Comfy sofa and plush chairs for lounging and movie nightsLarge flat-screen TV for streaming your favorite showsDirect access to a private balcony with seating for 4*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you’re whipping up breakfast or mixing sunset cocktails, the kitchen and dining area has everything you need.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesBar seating for 3 at the kitchen counterCozy dining table with seating for 2, great for casual meals or card games*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary King Suite - King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with dual vanities, soaking tub and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite - Queen bed, flat-screen TV and access to shared guest bathroomBunk Room - Twin-over-full bunk, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hallway access*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Enjoy everything The Villages of South Walton has to offer! Perfectly located between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this vibrant community provides easy access to boutique shopping, gourmet dining, outdoor activities, and more—all just steps away.Peddler’s Pavilion Shops & Dining - Just steps away! Enjoy a lively atmosphere with boutique shops, delicious eats, and a vibrant community vibe right at your doorstep.Rosemary Beach - A quick 4-minute walk. Stroll through charming cobblestone streets, lush greenery, and experience a quaint, upscale beach town ambiance.Alys Beach - A 12-minute walk. Discover stunning white architecture, laid-back luxury, and serene vibes perfect for a peaceful escape.Zero-Entry Pool & Splash Pad for Kids - Family-friendly fun with safe, shallow waters and exciting water play for the little ones.Heated Pool & Hot Tub (Seasonally Heated) - Relax in warmth and comfort, whether you're swimming or soaking under a clear sky.Poolside Grilling Stations - Savor the joy of outdoor cooking while lounging by the pool.On-Site Shopping & Dining Options - Ultimate convenience with everything you need just steps away!*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 211430
